system.description: This discipline covers most things that have to do with a race’s culture, religion, history , and legends. The person is familiar with the culture’s way of life, feasts, laws, and background. A character has level 1 of the discipline as a base (for the culture they originate from). Stormlanders, Mittlanders, Viranns, Wildfolks, Dwarves, and Elves, all have their own cultures.
system.summary: Deep knowledge of one culture: its way of life, feasts, laws and history; known by default for one’s own culture.
